newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Products cancels stock offer.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Products cancels stock offer.

text.p: Consolidated Products Inc said Tuesday it terminated its plan for a public offering of 2.35 million common shares due to market conditions.
The company also said that since its same-store sales and new locations were performing at expected rates, its net earnings for fiscal 1996 should meet analysts' estimates.
Analysts expect the company to earn $0.90 per share this year, according to First Call Research Network.
The company said it does not expect uncertainties related to rising food and labor costs to adversely affect operating margins in fiscal 1997.
The company also said the termination of the offering will not affect its growth plans through the fiscal year ended September 24, 1997.
It added that its 1996-1997 owned unit expansion will proceed as planned.
"The company will continue to evaluate its financing alternatives beyond fiscal 1997," it said.
